title: shadPS4 0.16.0: official stable release
summary: shadPS4 published 0.16.0 on June 1, 2026. The release record documents an official stable release for the PlayStation 4 emulator project.

blocks.text: The shadPS4 project published version 0.16.0 on June 1, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.
The official notes highlight the following changes: New VOP3P instruction definitions. SDWA instructions. Additional Neo-specific ALU instructions. Float16 packed arithmetic.
